name: SPIKES Protocol — Breaking Bad News

anchors.90-100: No errors; compassionate, clear medical register throughout
anchors.50-60: Some errors; does not significantly impair communication
anchors.10-20: Errors undermine ability to communicate sensitively

anchors.90-100: All clinical information conveyed accurately and at appropriate lay level
anchors.50-60: Some inaccuracies in medical information delivered
anchors.30-40: Multiple medical errors in information given to patient
anchors.10-20: Dangerous or significantly incorrect information delivered

anchors.90-100: Deliberate, compassionate pacing; silences used therapeutically
anchors.70-80: Mostly appropriate pacing; occasional awkward transitions
anchors.30-40: Frequently rushed or awkward; poor pacing
anchors.10-20: Severely disrupted by fluency or pacing issues

anchors.90-100: Exceptional empathy; responds to all patient cues; creates psychological safety
anchors.70-80: Good empathy; acknowledges emotion; some cues missed
anchors.50-60: Adequate but mechanical empathy; some emotional cues missed
anchors.30-40: Little empathic response; information delivery prioritized over patient emotion
anchors.10-20: No empathic response; patient distress ignored

checklist.item: S — Setting: ensured private setting and patient comfort acknowledged
P — Perception: asked what patient already knows/understands
I — Invitation: asked permission before sharing information
K — Knowledge: delivered news clearly without jargon; warning shot used
E — Emotions: acknowledged and responded to patient's emotional reaction
S — Strategy: provided clear plan and next steps
avoided medical jargon when delivering news
checked patient understanding at key points
provided written or printed information offer
used Teach-back method to verify patient understanding

empathy_markers: used silence therapeutically (allowed patient to process)
touched on patient's values or priorities
